# Nisal Palliyaguru

> AI & Cloud-Native Software Engineer based in Colombo, Sri Lanka, working
> remotely worldwide. Takes AI and cloud-native systems from prototype to
> production: computer vision on edge devices, LLM-backed automation, and the
> AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure underneath.

Available for new projects. Book a 30-minute call: https://cal.com/nisalrenuja

## Services

- **AI Product Build**: computer vision and LLM features shipped to real users.
  PyTorch/YOLO detection models exported to ONNX for edge inference, OCR and
  document-extraction pipelines, real-time inference with WebSocket streaming.
- **Cloud & System Architecture**: microservice and multi-tenant architectures
  in Go, NestJS and TypeScript; AWS infrastructure as code across EKS, RDS/Aurora,
  Lambda and CloudFormation; REST and GraphQL API design.
- **Platform & DevOps**: Kubernetes and GitOps with Argo CD, CI/CD pipelines,
  containerisation, observability and cost tuning on existing AWS estates.
- **Technical Advisory**: architecture and code review, build-vs-buy assessment
  for AI features, technical due diligence, team mentoring.

## Engagement

- Fixed-scope projects (quoted fixed price after a written brief), part-time
  retainers billed by the day, or short advisory engagements of a week or two.
- Based in Colombo, Sri Lanka (GMT+5:30). Overlaps a full European working day,
  the Middle East and Asia, and early US mornings. Remote or hybrid throughout.
- First call is 30 minutes and free: scoping and feasibility, not a sales pitch.

## Background

- 4+ years building production systems across 4 engineering roles, 2 of them
  senior or lead.
- Currently Software Engineer at Econsulate: real-time UAV/UGV sensor dashboards,
  OCR + Gemini API resume extraction, multi-tenant microservices for a Sri Lankan
  government ministry, PyTorch/YOLO detection models deployed via ONNX to edge.
- Previously Senior Software Engineer at Derana Macroentertainment (Macro Labs):
  Ada Derana 24x7 tri-language news platforms, ImpactNet civil-society platform on
  Kubernetes with GitOps, national election-night data visualisation, TopADS
  video classifieds marketplace.
- MSc in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, University of Moratuwa
  (in progress). BSc Computing (Software Engineering), Curtin University, Perth.
- AWS Academy certifications in Data Engineering, Cloud Data Pipelines, and
  Microservices/CI-CD. NVIDIA Deep Learning.
- BestWeb.lk 2024 Merit awards for news platforms built at Macro Labs.
